main_text.l: gunt,Hispaniam[?] ubegerunt, Asiam infestarunt, neque iniactam reliquerunt Europam, torrentis instar suis irruptionibus eam inun-dantes; dum regna potentissima Romanum, Constantinopolitanum, Trapezuntinum, la-befactarunt. Quibus praeterea ebrietas tribuitur. Unde sy[?] zare est inebriari. Hinc Plato: Σκύται δ' ἐ[?] Θράκες ἀκράτῳ πᾶσι δὲ τὰ πᾶσι χρώμενοι, γυναῖκες τε καὶ αὐτοὶ κατὰ τὰν ἱματίων καταχεόμενοι, καλὸν [illegible, ~12 letters] νενομίκασι. Notum τὸ σκυθοπιεῖν, sive σκυθίζειν pro ἀχεσ[?]τοπιεῖν. Et ξενικῶς[?], quicquid barbarum, sæ-vum. crudele est (nam & advenas pro victimis mactabant:) Scythicum id appellant eruditi: sicut Scythicam orationem duram, inhumanam, barbaram, &c.

Conflata est ex Chaldaica & Hebraica. Nam habet quaedam communia cum utraque, & quaedam diversa. Aliam quoque scripturam obtinuit; quae tamen in plerisque ad currentes Hebraeorum literas accedit. Hæc lingua in diuturno exi-tio Babylonico primordia cepit: ubi Iudaei, sicut fieri solet à victis, ad aucupandam victorum gratiâ, suam cum Chaldaica miscuerunt: ex qua commixtione illa prodiit. Hanc linguam sanctissimis labris suis consecravit

page.notes: Page number printed as "131" with the 1s set like capital I; read as 131. The "De Legib." marginal note is read as printed; its final letters are uncertain. The Greek word beginning the "Vnde" sentence is doubtful ("sy" read with [?]). "Hispaniam" is partly hidden by the binding. "ubegerunt" is printed with a gap; read as one word. "Romanum," is printed as found, not corrected to "Romanorum". The left-margin label is printed at the start of the paragraph; it is treated as a marginal note there. Possible printing error: "exi-tio" (exitio) as printed.
